text:
IFM Investors Pty Ltd grew its holdings in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 10.5% during the first quarter, according to its most recent 13F filing with the SEC. The institutional investor owned 159,871 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after buying an additional 15,130 shares during the period. Apple makes up 3.9% of IFM Investors Pty Ltd’s investment portfolio, making the stock its largest holding. IFM Investors Pty Ltd’s holdings in Apple were worth $26,823,000 as of its most recent SEC filing.
Several other institutional investors have also bought and sold shares of AAPL. Exane Derivatives acquired a new position in shares of Apple in the 4th quarter valued at $752,000. PGGM Investments raised its stake in shares of Apple by 9.6% in the 4th quarter. PGGM Investments now owns 2,305,200 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $390,109,000 after acquiring an additional 202,386 shares during the period. Epstein & White Financial LLC purchased a new position in shares of Apple in the 4th quarter valued at $969,000. Lenox Wealth Advisors Inc. raised its stake in shares of Apple by 47.7% in the 4th quarter. Lenox Wealth Advisors Inc. now owns 6,795 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,150,000 after acquiring an additional 2,193 shares during the period. Finally, GFS Private Wealth LLC purchased a new position in shares of Apple in the 4th quarter valued at $616,000. Hedge funds and other institutional investors own 58.61% of the company’s stock. A number of brokerages have recently commented on AAPL. Loop Capital raised their target price on shares of Apple from $195.00 to $210.00 and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research note on Friday, July 6th. Needham & Company LLC raised their target price on shares of Apple from $210.00 to $220.00 and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research note on Wednesday, August 1st. BidaskClub downgraded shares of Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating in a research note on Wednesday, May 23rd. DZ Bank reissued a “buy” rating on shares of Apple in a research note on Wednesday, August 1st. Finally, Sanford C. Bernstein set a $190.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the company a “neutral” rating in a research note on Monday, July 16th. Two research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, fifteen have issued a hold rating, thirty-one have assigned a buy rating and one has issued a strong buy rating to the company. The stock currently has an average rating of “Buy” and a consensus price target of $220.52.
In other news, CEO Timothy D. Cook sold 265,160 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction dated Monday, August 27th. The shares were sold at an average price of $217.79, for a total value of $57,749,196.40. The transaction was disclosed in a filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is accessible through this hyperlink . Also, insider Angela J. Ahrendts sold 6,568 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction dated Friday, June 15th. The stock was sold at an average price of $188.81, for a total transaction of $1,240,104.08. Following the completion of the sale, the insider now directly owns 79,476 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $15,005,863.56. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders sold a total of 400,621 shares of company stock valued at $85,281,642 in the last three months. Insiders own 0.08% of the company’s stock.
AAPL opened at $225.03 on Friday. The stock has a market capitalization of $1,079.86 billion, a PE ratio of 24.43, a P/E/G ratio of 1.71 and a beta of 1.16. Apple Inc. has a 1-year low of $149.16 and a 1-year high of $228.26. The company has a quick ratio of 1.24, a current ratio of 1.31 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its earnings results on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 earnings per share for the quarter, topping the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $2.18 by $0.16. The company had revenue of $53.27 billion during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $52.43 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.98% and a return on equity of 43.50%. The company’s revenue was up 17.3% on a year-over-year basis. During the same quarter in the previous year, the firm earned $1.67 EPS. equities analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 11.68 EPS for the current year.
The business also recently announced a quarterly dividend, which was paid on Thursday, August 16th. Stockholders of record on Monday, August 13th were given a $0.73 dividend. This represents a $2.92 annualized dividend and a dividend yield of 1.30%. The ex-dividend date was Friday, August 10th. Apple’s payout ratio is currently 31.70%.
About Apple
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
